description: This is a shell script intended to automate the restart, rebuild, and relaunch of the OpenClaw macOS application. It manages process termination, signing, building, packaging, and launching procedures, as well as handling lock files and external tool invocations.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of the OpenClaw application and related processes.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the macOS launch agent for OpenClaw.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent restarts.

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks for valid code signing identities on the system.

calls: bash -lc "cd '${ROOT_DIR}' && node openclaw.mjs daemon install --force --runtime node"
